basic_profile.bio: A Maryland-based newbie to the Reddit world, delving into niche hobbies like wet shaving and tattoo art. By day, I work as a freelance graphic designer, which allows me flexible online hours, mostly in the evenings and late nights. I’m single and enjoy exploring upscale gun accessories as part of my growing interest in firearms. Dislikes include overly strict online rules and generic advice.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge stems from a mix of online tutorials, community forums, and personal experimentation in graphic design and tattoo artistry. Recently, I've been educating myself on firearm accessories by following expert discussions on niche subreddits.
